_comment: Phrasings for the ready-made answers. positives: [expected answer id, question]. negatives: questions that must go to the model, never a ready-made answer (precision is the point). Added to over time; a first-contact test on never-seen wording scored 58% and 35% on two fresh sets (and 0 wrong answers after the final fix), so these grow as real questions turn up.
